channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tony Allen | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tony Allen from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Glen Davis on Kendrick Perkins, Darius Miles, Tony Allen
item.description:
“Kendrick Perkins, you see him on ESPN. Tony Allen—he was literally the third person on the indictment, with his wife. He's not walking in jail. Darius Miles—he's not walking in jail. And these guys got money, like thousands of dollars. How'd I end up in jail and these guys are on probation/walking free; their whole life is still intact. “I think the NBA let the feds pick who they wanted to choose. 180 people were investigated/supenoed. We didn't hear about all those people. We just heard about the 22 people that got caught, or that got jammed in the situation. A lot of people pleaded out. They didn't go to jail. They didn't even go get time served.”

Glen Davis on Kendrick Perkins, Darius Miles, Tony Allen, Sep 5, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Glen Davis on Corey Maggette, Gilbert Arenas, Matt Barnes, Tony Allen
item.description:
“Matt Barnes, Stephen Jack; all those people were investigated. Gilbert Arenas, Corey Maggette, Cutino Mobley; thousands of NBA players were investigated. They just let some of them go to jail. Some of them, the fed got, like, Tony Allen. He didn't go to jail. Whatever he did to get free.”

Glen Davis on Corey Maggette, Gilbert Arenas, Matt Barnes, Tony Allen, Sep 5, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Metta World Peace, Tony Allen, Jrue Holiday
item.description:
“There's a group of 3 that always a light bulb went off when they're on the court. Jrue Holiday, Tony Allen and Ron Artest.”

Stephen Curry on Metta World Peace, Tony Allen, Jrue Holiday, Aug 1, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Tony Allen
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Marcus Smart on comparison to Tony Allen:

“People were sending it to me, the similarities... it's funny, because when I first met Tony Allen, I was at the top 100 camp...we were playing 1 on 1...I stepped up, I got (Allen), don't worry about it... I got the stop and the gym goes crazy.”

Marcus Smart on Tony Allen, Jul 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Tony Allen, Eddie House, Glen Davis, Leon Powe
item.description:
Rivers said on Sunday at practice.

“There’s a lot of teams that go through that. We won a title doing that one year. We literally did. Big Baby (Glen Davis) or Leon Powe. Tony Allen or Eddie House. They didn’t play every night, but I thought to our team, it was very healthy because it was a competition.”

Doc Rivers on Tony Allen, Eddie House, Glen Davis, Leon Powe, Dec 18, 2022. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Tony Allen
item.description:
Darnell Mayberry:Alvin Gentry on if players are scared of Tony Allen:

“I️ don’t know if scared is the word, but I️ don’t know if you wanna challenge him.”

Alvin Gentry on Tony Allen, Nov 4, 2017. Source: Twitter @DarnellMayberry.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Rajon Rondo, Tony Allen
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Gentry on shooting:

“I don’t know if you classify Rondo as a great shooter,but he’s a great basketball player. Same thing with Tony Allen”

Alvin Gentry on Rajon Rondo, Tony Allen, Sep 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Rajon Rondo, Tony Allen
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Anthony Davis:

“Our defense is going to keep improving, adding Tony Allen & Rondo. They're some of the best defensive players in the league”

Anthony Davis on Rajon Rondo, Tony Allen, Sep 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Gerald Green on Tony Allen, Avery Bradley
item.description:
Jay King:Green on Avery Bradley:

“I’ve played a lot of basketball. And he might be the best defender I’ve ever had, probably besides Tony Allen.”

Gerald Green on Tony Allen, Avery Bradley, Apr 22, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Tony Allen
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Ginobili on Memphis losing a key piece:

“Tony Allen was their beast, their defensive anchor, their best defensive player.”

Manu Ginobili on Tony Allen, Apr 14, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Tony Allen
item.description:
Serena Winters:Kobe on Tony Allen's defense:

“He does his homework. He's old school. He'll watch film & he'll know where you're going to go before you go.”

Kobe Bryant on Tony Allen, Dec 27, 2015. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Tony Allen
item.description:
When asked to name who defends him the best, Bryant responded,

“Tony Allen. He’s not the biggest guy, but he knows how to guard you.”

Kobe Bryant on Tony Allen, Oct 12, 2011. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Tony Allen
item.description:
the Celtics general manager said following yesterday’s press conference to introduce Jermaine O’Neal.

“We tried to get him back. It was not a financial decision (by Allen), so I think you really have to ask him that question. “We have a lot of decisions that we have to make,”

Danny Ainge on Tony Allen, Jul 15, 2010. Source: Boston Herald.
